workerImageAcceptance.howTheSubjectIsChosen: The acceptance workflow reads sourceSha and immutableRegistryDigest from this file rather than from a typed input, so the image it examines is the one this record names.
workerImageAcceptance.whatIsOwed: an authenticated pull by digest, an OCI revision naming this source, non-root, a healthcheck, fail-closed exit 2 startup, graceful SIGTERM, an empty scratch and a clean secret scan

publicationArtifactEvidenceBasis: The publication artifact was NOT downloaded here: the download redirects to blob storage the egress proxy denies with 403. The digest, run id, artifact id and source SHA are read from the workflow run's own job log, which printed the digest before the artifact was uploaded and refuses any value that is not sha256 plus 64 hex characters.

supersededWorkerImageAcceptanceC065.whyThisMatters: The previous image failed this same workflow on run 34262980303 by exiting 1 on a missing runtime data file instead of the required unconfigured exit 2. That failure is what the republication was for, and this run is the measurement that it is fixed.
supersededWorkerImageAcceptanceC065.whatItDoesNotEstablish: Acceptance is read-only. It deploys nothing, starts no worker, touches neither staging nor production, and is not an end-to-end delivery proof. No SBOM or SLSA provenance attestation exists for this image; the source binding rests on the OCI revision label and the image-input fingerprint.
supersededWorkerImageAcceptanceC065.whyNoArtifact: This workflow uploads no artifact; its evidence is the run metadata and job logs.
